name: Chore Strike
hook: Dodge the $350 cleaning fee chore list before checkout morning arrives
tagline: A exhausted vacationer lounges on the couch while a laminated 14-page chore checklist grows legs and violently demands lawn mowing and gutter scrubbing. Cashing out grabs your carry-on luggage and leaps into an Uber right past the front lawn. Crashing summons an unhinged Superhost who hits you with a 1-star review and a surprise $900 deep-clean bill.
